metadata.title: 東北本線 黒磯→福島 OSM在来線本線形状
metadata.query: See queries and queryBoundingBoxes for original and extension requests.
metadata.projection: Local equirectangular; R=6371008.8m; reference latitude 36.9701908deg; origin is projected Kuroiso station on selected track
metadata.selectedTrack: Contiguous western/left northbound 1067mm conventional Tohoku mainline from the original Kuroiso track; excludes Shinkansen, tagged sidings/yards, and the dead-end Koriyama spur.
notes: Map-derived horizontal geometry, not surveyed engineering alignment or curve radii.
Original OSM vertices retained; distance coordinate is piecewise linearly calibrated between station projections to RailLab station distances.
Coordinates preserve the actual map shape. This small per-section chainage calibration does not relocate geometry.
Station anchors are nearest projections of OSM station label nodes onto the selected rail, not exact cab stopping marks.
No measured elevation/gradient or real operational speed restrictions are included.
Shin-Shirakawa station label node includes the Shinkansen/shared station label; projection uses only the conventional 1067mm track.
extensionNotes: Fukushima terminus is the OSM railway station node 206431759 projected onto conventional 1067mm rail, not the city centre.
Station label nodes at shared Shinkansen stations are projected only onto the conventional mainline.
